notes.title: A Tale in the Garden bug bixes are here
notes.content:
Hey Outposters!

We are delighted to announce some fixes that have come to A Tale in the Garden.

Thank you, everyone, for reporting these bugs and suggesting improvements.

Full Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] New animation speeds
[*] New in-game Frida's Sketchbook text available
[*] Visual feedback while clicking
[*] Sounds and audio fixes
[/list]

As always, thank you so much for your support. We hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: New languages are available!
notes.content:
Hey Outposter!

Filomena has been busy learning new languages over the past month.

Please note: she isn’t fluent yet, so you might spot a few spelling mistakes.

The available languages now include:

[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] German
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[/list]

P.S. Want to help her improve in your language? Let us know!

Enjoy the enhancements she has made and dive back into A Tale in the Garden!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hey Outposter!

Filomena has taken the time to deal with some bugs in her garden. Here’s what she fixed:

[list]
[*] Fixed recurring event start issues
[*] Resolved save deletion when starting a New Game
[*] Repaired unclickable tiles
[*] Added particles VFX
[*] Updated sketchbook font
[/list]

Enjoy the improvements she has made and dive back into A Tale in the Garden!
